title: Part Number Record
description: Cross-reference from one company's part number to a master product: a vendor SKU, a customer's internal PN, a distributor number, a manufacturer number for a generic part, or a GTIN. Reified as a record (not just identifiers) because it carries its own facts: who issued it, pack quantity, UOM conversion, cost, MOQ, lead time and dates. Rule: one product -> many part_numbers; one part_number -> exactly one product. Generic parts (an M6x20 hex bolt) have many mfr part_numbers all pointing at the one generic product. The searchable value also goes in identifiers[<pn_type>_pn] on this record; the toolchain builds the (issuer, value) -> product index from these records.

relations.description: Exactly one rel='product' edge; plus rel='issuer' (the organization that owns the number) when known.

pn.description: The number exactly as the issuer writes it.

pn_normalized.description: Upper-cased, punctuation and spaces removed - the match key.

pn_type.description: Role of the issuer for this number.

description.description: The issuer's own description, kept verbatim for matching.

conversion.description: How many master-product base units one issuer unit equals (e.g. box of 100 -> 100).

price_breaks.description: Quantity price breaks from this source.

min_qty.description: Smallest order quantity that gets this price.

order_multiple.description: Orders must be a multiple of this quantity.

lead_time_days.description: Lead time in days when not in stock.

stock.description: Units in stock at the source.

as_of.description: When price and stock were read.

commercial.description: Commercial terms from this issuer. Volatile: refreshed by vendor-API ingests; history stays in the lake.

preferred.description: Preferred source among several vendor part_numbers for the same product.
